cs.t: I'm using keyboard.io model 01, with the quiet switches, and in general really like it.  Took a little getting used to, and I periodically find the lack of a right-hand Cmd button/left side option a little inconvenient, but overall it'd be _really_ hard to move back to standard layout kb. Other complaint would be that self-serviceability of the switches is pretty poor (I broke a kb trying to replace a bad switch and doing a lazy job desoldering, destroying a pad, and having a hard time finding a suitable trace to try and run a wire to).  Sounds like serviceability is  something they are rectifying in a new iteration that should be getting released sometime this year.  I'll be picking up one of the new ones when they are available.  On balance, has been the best overall KB experience I've had.
